builders.name: Madhu Guru
builders.bio: Sr Director, AI at Meta; Prev: Google - Led Gemini, Veo, Nano Banana.
builders.text:
Part of the disconnect is that the name “data” massively undersells what it truly represents in model development.

People who are not close to model development think of data as this  inert commodity you buy and shovel into a model, like coal.

In reality great data encodes incredibly high value knowledge, taste and expertise, often articulated and structured in ways that did not exist previously. 

This makes it one of THE fundamental building blocks for creating increasingly capable intelligence across domains. 

Data will continue to be incredibly central to the intelligence industry .

builders.text:
Sometimes you need to travel abroad to deeply appreciate just how inspirational America is to the rest of the world.

Countries and individuals aspire to have an entreprenurial ecosystem like ours. A capital market base like ours.

They don't want to be like China or the UK or Denmark. 

They want to be like America.

And this is particularly true for the most ambitious people in every country. They are students of how America builds.

This doesn't mean we cannot do better ourselves. We must and we will.

- GPT-6.2 Astra was the strongest solo agent but exhibited negative scaling beyond 8 agents.

You can post on social media every day and still be a very private person; the two are not contradictory 

Many people have the misconception that sharing your thoughts online means turning your whole life into an open book for others to see. This can’t be further from the truth

I post almost every day but I only share a tiny sliver of my life & thoughts, probably less than 1%. I only share what I’m comfortable with sharing

The key is to find out which 1% is at the intersection of “interesting to others” and “comfortable for you”
